customNotable: First recorded storm in the official HURDAT database.
Regarded as the worst hurricane in the region since 1819.
Tied with Laura (2020) and Ida (2021) as the strongest hurricane to make landfall in Louisiana.
Tied for 7th strongest landfalling U.S. hurricane on record.
Noted as the most severe hurricane in Plaquemines Parish since 1812.
Influenced and caused damage to several ships during an active expedition in the American Civil War.
One of three hurricanes (along with the 1938 New England hurricane and Carol 1954) to strike New England as a major hurricane.
Strongest hurricane to make landfall in Rhode Island on record.
One of six storms to produce hurricane-force winds in Maine (along with Carol 1953, Edna 1954, Donna 1960, Gerda 1969, and Gloria 1985).
Lieutenant S.M. Saxby of the Royal Navy predicted in November 1868 that an unusually violent storm would produce very high tides on October 5, 1869.
